title: Protocol
description: Wire format of Skill-Based Front, generated from gow_protocol.

AckMsg.description:
Result of the command ``seq``: accepted (``reject_code`` is ``None``) or rejected.

``applied_tick``: the tick at whose start the command was validated and, if accepted, applied.
``path``: for an accepted ``move``, the nodes from the group's node to ``dest``; for an
accepted ``transfer`` (DEC-18), the nodes from ``from_node`` to ``to_node`` (the client draws
it and never computes it); ``None`` otherwise.
``arrive_tick``: for an accepted ``move``, the tick the group reaches ``dest`` (planned delay
included; DEC-22, item 10); for an accepted ``transfer``, the tick the charges reach
``to_node``; both if nothing stops them; ``None`` otherwise.
``reject_code``: code of the simulation's ``Reject`` (``NOT_FOUND_OR_HIDDEN``,
``NOT_ENOUGH_CP``, ``RECRUIT_COOLDOWN``, ... from SIM-04 #20).
AckMsg.title: AckMsg

BuildPublic.description: Road upgrades by a city (``build`` of the ruleset, DEC-16).

charges_per_level.description: One price per new level ``2..3`` (DEC-22), ascending.

BuildPublic.title: BuildPublic

CapacityPublic.description: Overcrowding attrition (``capacity`` of the ruleset), for the countdown of ui-style 12.

attrition_ticks.description: Ticks over the capacity in a row before one unit dies.

grace_ticks.description: Ticks after a capture in which the garrison is not counted.

CapacityPublic.title: CapacityPublic

seq.description: Client sequence number of the command, strictly increasing; ``ack`` echoes it.

CostsPublic.description: Command costs in hundredths of CP (``orders.cost`` of the ruleset).
CostsPublic.title: CostsPublic

CpPublic.description: CP regeneration: ``per_period`` hundredths every ``period_ticks`` ticks, up to ``cap``.
CpPublic.title: CpPublic

Detail.description: How much a player sees of a node or an edge (DEC-04, mechanics.md, section 10).
Detail.title: Detail

EconomyPublic.description: The charge production the stance menu shows (``economy`` of the ruleset, DEC-02).

charges_per_cp.description: Charges per whole CP put into charges.

passive_period_ticks.description: The capital makes ``passive_amount`` charges every ``passive_period_ticks`` in any stance.

EconomyPublic.title: EconomyPublic

width.description:
Road level the player knows (DEC-17, DEC-22): the current one unless ``detail`` is
``fog``; in fog the last seen level, or 1 if never seen. Never above the true level.

kind.description: Road type the player knows, by the same rule (DEC-22, item 8): ``none`` on level 1.

detail.description: ``PRESENCE`` or ``FOG``: DEC-04 never shows numbers on edges.

upgrade_gain.description: Only for own internal edges that can still be upgraded.

ErrorMsg.description:
A protocol-level error (malformed message, rate limit, ...); game rejections are ``ack``.

``message`` is a short text for developers. It never echoes the client's input.
ErrorMsg.title: ErrorMsg

EventMsg.description:
A simulation event visible to the player (``gow_sim.state.Event``; PRO-03 filters them).

``data`` mirrors ``Event.data``: flat fields with integer, string, boolean or null values.
Entity ids in ``data`` are opaque ids (strings), map node and edge ids are integers.
EventMsg.title: EventMsg

GroupView.description: An own group. Enemy groups appear only as ``Seen`` summaries of places.
GroupView.title: GroupView

HelloMsg.description: First message of a connection. The token is never in the URL, a log or an error text.
HelloMsg.title: HelloMsg

IntentView.description: Public part of a planned order or a mode switch: no group id and no group size.

target.description: ``None`` for an intent without a destination (``defense``).

IntentView.title: IntentView

LevelPrice.description: Charges from the city warehouse for raising a road to level ``width`` (DEC-16, DEC-22).
LevelPrice.title: LevelPrice

base_width.description: Road level at the start: always 1 (DEC-22).

name.description: Map id: ``map_id`` in ``welcome`` and in the replay header.

version.description: Revision of the map, bumped on every edit.

width.description: World size: coordinates are in ``[0, width] x [0, height]``, ``y`` grows down.

MapMirrorFile.description: Symmetry table: id (as a JSON string key) -> id of the mirrored node or edge.
MapMirrorFile.title: MapMirrorFile

kind.description: Node kind: its capacity is ``capacity.by_kind`` of the ruleset (DEC-22).

winner.description: ``None`` is a draw: always for ``double_defeat``, possible for ``timer``, else never.

vp.description: Final VP of both players, by player id.

rating.description: Rating change of the receiving player; ``None``: the match is not rated (DEC-06).

Mode.description: Group mode (mechanics.md, section 3; effects: DEC-08). Roads are built by cities (DEC-16).
Mode.title: Mode

planned.description: Planned order (DEC-08): costlier, visible to everyone as an intent, starts after a delay.

NodeBuild.description: A road level the city builds (DEC-16): ``edge`` is one of the city's roads.

done_tick.description: The tick the width grows; only for an own build.

NodeBuild.title: NodeBuild

NodeKind.description: Kind of a node (DEC-22, item 1; DEC-23, item 1): its capacity is ``capacity.by_kind``.
NodeKind.title: NodeKind

capacity.description: Capacity by the node kind (DEC-22, item 1): public and exact for every node.

warehouse.description: Charges in the warehouse; only for ``EXACT`` nodes.

seen.description: Current sighting for ``EXACT`` and ``PRESENCE``; for ``FOG`` the last one, or ``None``.

build.description: The city's road build (DEC-16): own always, an enemy one only while its edge is unfogged.

attrition_in.description:
Own node only: ticks until the next unit dies of overcrowding (the garrison exceeds the
capacity and the grace after a capture is over). ``None`` for every other node.

grace_left.description:
Own node only: ticks the grace after a capture still lasts while the garrison exceeds the
capacity. ``None`` for every other node.

priority.description:
Own city only: its supply priority (DEC-18, item 1). ``None`` for provinces, the enemy's
and neutral nodes (DEC-18, item 8).

starve_in.description:
Own cut-off city only: ticks until its garrison next starves (DEC-19, item 8). ``None``
for every other node.

OnEdgeLoc.description: Moving along ``edge`` away from ``from_node``; ``progress`` in thousandths.
OnEdgeLoc.title: OnEdgeLoc

OrderView.description: Current order of an own group: the path is the server's, the client never computes it.
OrderView.title: OrderView

OrdersPublic.description: Delays of planned orders and modes, and the stance cooldown (``orders`` of the ruleset).
OrdersPublic.title: OrdersPublic

PacketView.description:
Own charges on the way along a path of roads (mechanics.md, section 7; DEC-18, item 5).

``edge`` is the current road, travelled away from ``from_node`` during
``depart_tick..arrive_tick``; ``path``: the nodes still to reach, the end of ``edge`` first,
the destination last; ``dest_tick``: the tick it reaches the destination if nothing stops it.
``transfer``: a one-off transfer (DEC-18, item 6), not the automatic dispatch.
PacketView.title: PacketView

PauseMsg.description:
Pause a private match (DEC-05): one pause per player, at most ``paused.ends_in_s`` long.

Refused with ``error`` ``PAUSE_DENIED`` in a rated match, with no pause left or while paused.
PauseMsg.title: PauseMsg

PausedMsg.description: The pause state of the match changed (also sent after ``welcome`` while paused).

by.description: Player who paused; ``None`` when ``paused`` is false.

ends_in_s.description: Whole seconds until the pause ends by itself; ``None`` when ``paused`` is false.

PausedMsg.title: PausedMsg

PingMsg.description: Application-level ping for RTT (browsers do not expose protocol pings).

id.description: Echoed in ``pong``; the client measures the time itself.

PingMsg.title: PingMsg

Priority.description: Supply priority of a city (DEC-18, item 1): only the order of delivery, not the target.
Priority.title: Priority

RatingChange.description:
The rating of the receiving player before and after a rated match (RAT-02, #75).

Both numbers are the displayed rating (``r - 2 * RD``, RAT-01), rounded to integers.
RatingChange.title: RatingChange

ReachMsg.description:
Answer to ``reach_query``, computed by the server on the state after tick ``tick``
(DEC-20, D5; DEC-22, item 10). The client highlights ``nodes``, shows their travel time and
suggests splitting the group for ``split``; it computes neither. Both lists are empty for a
group that is unknown, not own, hidden or on an edge.

nodes.description: Nodes a ``move`` of the group is accepted to now, by node id.

split.description: Nodes a ``move`` is rejected to with ``STACK_LIMIT``: only a smaller group gets there.

ReachMsg.title: ReachMsg

ticks.description: Ticks of the path once the group departs (a planned order waits its delay first).

ReachQueryMsg.description:
Ask where an own standing group can be ordered to and how long it takes (DEC-20, D5).

The answer is ``reach``. The interface sends it when a group is selected; the connection's
message rate limit covers it like every other message.
ReachQueryMsg.title: ReachQueryMsg

ResumeMsg.description: End a pause early. Only the player who paused may; else ``error`` ``PAUSE_DENIED``.
ResumeMsg.title: ResumeMsg

ResyncMsg.description: Ask for a full snapshot now (after a gap in snapshots).
ResyncMsg.title: ResyncMsg

RoadGain.description: What one more level of one road type adds (DEC-22, item 7).

speed_pct.description: Packet speed gain in percentage points.

amount.description: Gain in charges per road and dispatch period.

RoadGain.title: RoadGain

RoadKind.description: Type of a road (DEC-22, item 2): chosen by the first upgrade, never changes after.
RoadKind.title: RoadKind

Seen.description:
What the player sees, or last saw, of one node or edge (``gow_sim.state.Sighting``).

``enemy_modes``: distinct modes of the enemy groups there; empty means no enemy groups.
``enemy_units`` and ``enemy_charged`` are totals, present only when ``level`` is ``EXACT``.
``level`` is never ``FOG``: a place in fog is not seen, it keeps an older ``Seen``.
Seen.title: Seen

SelfView.description: Own counters; the enemy's CP and stance are never in a view (AGENTS.md, section 4.4).
SelfView.title: SelfView

SetPriorityCmd.description: Supply priority ``level`` of the own city ``node`` (DEC-18, item 1).
SetPriorityCmd.title: SetPriorityCmd

SnapshotMsg.description: The player's view after tick ``tick``. Only the latest one matters (AGENTS.md, 5.3).
SnapshotMsg.title: SnapshotMsg

n.description: Units that leave ``group`` as a new group.

Stance.description: CP stance: the share of CP regeneration that goes into charges (DEC-02).
Stance.title: Stance

StancePctPublic.description: ``economy.stance_to_charges_pct``: the share of the CP quantum put into charges, in %.
StancePctPublic.title: StancePctPublic

TerrainDefensePublic.description: ``terrain.defense_mod``: charges added to the node defender's pool; may be negative.
TerrainDefensePublic.title: TerrainDefensePublic

TransferCmd.description:
Ship ``n`` charges from the warehouse of the own city ``from_node`` to the own city
``to_node`` along own roads, once (DEC-18, item 6). The ``ack`` carries the path and the
arrival tick; the client never computes them.
TransferCmd.title: TransferCmd

UpgradeGain.description:
What the next road level would give, per road type (DEC-22, item 7): both types on
level 1, only the road's own type on level 2.
UpgradeGain.title: UpgradeGain

UpgradeRoadCmd.description:
The own city ``node`` raises the internal road ``edge`` by one level (DEC-16, DEC-22).

``kind`` is required by the first upgrade (level 1 -> 2) and chooses the road type; for the
second it may be omitted or must equal the road's type (``ROAD_KIND_MISMATCH`` otherwise).
UpgradeRoadCmd.title: UpgradeRoadCmd

vp.description: VP of both players, by player id; public (DEC-04).

nodes.description: Every node of the map, ``nodes[i].id == i``.

edges.description: Every edge of the map, ``edges[i].id == i``.

WelcomeMsg.description: Answer to a valid ``hello``, also after a reconnect; a full ``snapshot`` follows.

map_id.description: The map graph itself is public and comes over HTTP (``GET /api/maps/{id}``).

last_seq.description:
Highest ``seq`` of this player the server has accepted; ``0`` if none. After a reconnect
the client resends only its commands with a greater ``seq``.

nicks.description:
Nicks of the two players by player id (ui-style U3); the bot of a bot match is ``Bot``.
Not secret (visible in the waiting room and the queue), so not part of the ``PlayerView``.

WelcomeMsg.title: WelcomeMsg
